limits: Candidate conventions and local admissibility sets are assumptions, not validated by these calculations.
Distinct dossiers are the exception and adjudication units; repeated readings of one dossier do not give additional coordinates.
Query minima are universal for compatible transcripts on this finite frame, not expected adaptive costs or human review time.
Only k=0,...,8 is analysed for the exact archived-query minimum.
The mathematical proof, retained evidence audit and finite computational checks are separate sources of support.
